column2: The Empire of [e_spain.GetName] once ruled a vast swathe of [e_iberia.GetName] through a legendary union of two great crowns whose might stretched across all the continents of the world. Now perhaps you will be able to reclaim this most ancient legacy?
You can proclaim yourself emperor of all the Germans, like the Kaisers of Old!
Unify all the German Kingdoms under the new Kaiser!
You can proclaim yourself Emperor in opposition to Brussels!
You can proclaim yourself holy Emperor of the Rhine!

[k_kurdistan.GetName], long the ancient homeland of the [kurdish.GetName], has been divided in the great games of others. Perhaps, if you were to unify the fragmented Kurdish lands, you could stand a better chance in challenging these great Kings?
Unify the Lands of the Holy Crown of Saint Stephen
The lands around the Carpathians should belong to the one Holy Crown, and we shall make sure that they will belong to it forever.
The Bosnian lands should belong to the one Holy Crown, and we shall make sure that they will belong to it forever.
The Serbian lands should belong to the one Holy Crown, and we shall make sure that they will belong to it forever.
The Galician lands should belong to the one Holy Crown, and we shall make sure that they will belong to it forever.

Long ago, [e_kazakhstan.GetName], the ancient home of the [Root.Culture.GetName] people, was split asunder into three Jüz, never to be one again. Today, as ruler of all three hordes, you can proclaim yourself Khagan of all [e_kazakhstan.GetName]!
[k_sicilia.GetName] once existed as a union with the Kingdom of Naples. Perhaps we can make a new union with Meridione, which may last another hundred if not a thousand years!

[e_russia.GetName] once existed as a powerful state both admired and feared by the rest of Eurasia. As your realm grows ever larger, many quietly whisper that the Russian Bear has once more awaken from its long slumber, a real tour de force that will surely shape the future of Eurasia like in the days long ago.

[e_soyuz.GetName] once existed as a powerful state both admired and feared by the rest of Eurasia. As your realm grows ever larger your armies march to an ancient hymn of a memory of an old Internationale once enjoyed by the Union of all peoples, perhaps this is the sign of that the struggle has not yet been lost?

[e_hetmanate.GetName] once existed as a powerful state admired for their resistance and courage across Eastern Europe. Your armies march as a proud host out from the European Plains striking for new lands and pastors for your ever expanding realm.
[e_yugoslavia.GetName] is under [jedinstvo.GetName] control once again, I should lead the faith as Marshal Tito once did when he ruled [e_yugoslavia.GetName].
The ruler of Yugoslavia becomes the [jedinstvo.GetName] Head of Faith.
